notes.title: Testament is truly affordable now
notes.content: We appreciate the kind words from the people who have been supporting us since our announcement while our team carefully hears the criticism about our work and certainly hopes to use all of this as an encouragement to improve Testament and get more players to join its community.As a small indie developer all that matters to us is to get our game out there and be seen by the wider audience. Therefore, we have decided to take a big step forward and bring the price of Testament down to a point that could be purchased with minimal effort. Our team is truly proud and blessed to have been able to get Testament through the finish line despite all the hardship during the covid pandemic and other challenges for an indie team. We sincerely hope you enjoy playing it.

notes.title: Testament is available now!
notes.content:
Today we are happy to present Testament. Our team is extremely grateful for the support of the community during the Steam NEXT FEST and your feedback has been very valuable during the fest.
We have added a special 15% launch discount as a token of gratitude. The localization team is working on the Polish, Arabic & Korean localization to add it to the game soon.

notes.title: Our demo is about to expire!
notes.content:
[b]We would like to appreciate your amazing support during Next Fest.[/b] 
After carefully reviewing the comments and feedback, our team has worked on a number of the issues that were addressed by the respected community. We even added some of the suggested features that could fit the game's overall progress.  
Testament's latest build is in good shape and as the release of the game is in less than two weeks, we need to remove the demo and get ready to make the full game available to play.

notes.title: Testament's demo is available now!!
notes.content:
Fairyship Games is excited to confirm that its forthcoming action-adventure RPG Testament: The Order of High Human will launch on Steam on Thursday 13th July 2023.

To celebrate the news, as well as releasing a brand new trailer - which you can watch on the store page - the first publicly available demo of Testament: The Order of High Human is available on Steam Next Fest for free now, opening up more than an hour of the game as it currently stands to anyone who wants to take it on.

Testament: The Order of High Human has been in development for the past four and a half years by a small team of 15 people with a passion for storytelling.
